description: Documented at higher rates in sulfur-mustard-exposed populations, alongside cancer. For the exposed parent each pregnancy is a source of dread rather than anticipation.
energy_note: Every pregnancy as a test of what was done to you.

aspect: The decision whether to have children at all
description: Exposed survivors face a choice nobody else faces: whether their exposure makes parenthood irresponsible. There is rarely any genetic counselling available to inform it.
energy_note: Deciding about a child on no information.

aspect: A disabled child, in a system with nothing for them
description: Where the outcome does occur, the family faces lifelong care in a place with no specialist services and a sanctioned supply chain for equipment.
energy_note: The war, delivered to a child, in 2026.

aspect: Attribution is impossible and the family does it anyway
description: No mechanism exists to establish whether a given birth defect came from a given exposure. The parents assign the cause themselves, and carry it, without any way to be right or wrong.
energy_note: Guilty of something nobody can confirm.
